case.summary: Customer C13171 alerted the bank after identifying an unauthorized online charge of $55.68 (transaction 3558054) on card C13171-K2. Subsequent analysis revealed an episode of three rapid online transactions for product C occurring between 2016-12-19 21:48:32 and 2016-12-19 22:08:56, resulting in a total exposure of $166.97. The supervised graph model evaluated the activity with a calibrated fraud probability of 0.98, consistent with five similar historical card-not-present fraud cases. Card blocking and case creation were executed to halt further unauthorized transactions.
